description: Source code defining parameter handling and constants for the go-restful package, including parameter types, collection formats, and parameter data structures.

classes.name: Parameter
classes.description: Represents a request parameter with methods to set its properties.

classes.name: ParameterData
classes.description: Holds detailed information about a parameter, including type, format, and validation constraints.

methods.name: Data
methods.description: Returns the current state of the parameter.

methods.name: Required
methods.description: Sets whether the parameter is required.

methods.name: AllowMultiple
methods.description: Sets whether multiple values are allowed.

methods.name: AddExtension
methods.description: Adds or updates an extension property.

methods.name: AllowEmptyValue
methods.description: Sets whether empty values are allowed.

methods.name: PossibleValues
methods.description: Sets possible values for the parameter.

methods.name: DataType
methods.description: Sets the data type of the parameter.

methods.name: DataFormat
methods.description: Sets the data format for Swagger UI.

methods.name: Description
methods.description: Sets the description of the parameter.

methods.name: CollectionFormat
methods.description: Sets the collection format for array types.

methods.name: MinItems
methods.description: Sets the minimum number of items.

methods.name: MaxItems
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of items.

methods.name: UniqueItems
methods.description: Sets whether items must be unique.
